dedupe_keys.name: opera dswx hls flood extent mosaics for the 2024 rio grande do sul floods

description: The OPERA ArcGIS Pro Toolbox authors publish two surface-water mosaics for the May 2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods in Brazil. Zenodo lists pre-flood and during-flood ZIP files under CC BY 4.0; the description identifies GeoTIFF rasters made from NASA OPERA DSWx-HLS products. Baseline observations span 5–10 April 2024 and peak-flood observations 5–7 May. The paired maps can help calibrate inundation simulations or test exposure estimates for roads, utilities and buildings. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these two event mosaics. A limitation is that they are example outputs of a particular toolbox workflow, not continuous flood-depth measurements or a validated chronology at every location. Cloud, water-classification and mosaic choices may influence visible extents. Exact raster resolution and pixel values were not independently checked because the ZIP files were not downloaded.
